thm:first-main.statement: Specified large lists and the whole deck mix at the stated linear-in-d clocks.
thm:first-main.conditions: n=2^d;independent fair switches in fixed cyclic coordinate order;every deterministic start and specified ordered list.
thm:first-main.constants_and_limits: 256d:k<=7n/8 TV=o(1);1024d:k<=15n/16 TV<=n^-3/2 eventually;full2048d TV=o(1). Actual InformationMain matches these conclusions;its full-deck branch reuses1600d monotonicity,not the natural eight-factor proof.

lem:marginal-averaging.statement: Feasible observed full paths leave unvisited time-edge coins independent fair;conditional tagged mass follows average-or-transport.
lem:marginal-averaging.conditions: Observed labels and tag fixed independently of coins;feasible labelled path cylinder;uniform reference on actual available set.
lem:marginal-averaging.constants_and_limits: Prefix law at s unaffected by later specified visited coins. Not arbitrary selected/censored observations or independence of hidden positions.

lem:sequential-tv.statement: Injective joint-tuple TV is at most the sum of mean conditional-coordinate TV under actual prefixes.
lem:sequential-tv.conditions: Conditional base-information variant requires its available set measurable;path refinement then coarsening retains reference endpoints.
lem:sequential-tv.constants_and_limits: No coordinate independence;sum is under actual prefix law. Second label lem:sequential is alias,not a new result.

lem:concentration.statement: Bounded independent-variable differences and bounded martingale increments give exponential tails.
lem:concentration.conditions: Independent coordinates with change bounds c_j,or adapted martingale increments bounded in absolute value.
lem:concentration.constants_and_limits: Independent case exp(-2u²/sum c_j²);martingale exp(-u²/(2sum c_j²));all-zero bounds constant. Applied before full path conditioning;old Hoeffding/Azuma mechanism.

noise:memory.statement: Signed available mass has exact finite-memory noise and covariance identities.
noise:memory.conditions: Arbitrary deterministic real zero-sum input supported on available sites;cyclic distinct-coordinate averages;fresh independent fair coins.
noise:memory.constants_and_limits: E||xi||²=w/2;a_t=sum_j1..d2^-j w_(t-j);a_next=(a_t+w_t-2^-d w_(t-d))/2. Covariance adds mixed-edge quarter-weight pair-difference Gram terms. No normality or independent full trajectories.

noise:halves.statement: Previous use of the current coordinate supplies a uniform opposite-half energy gain.
noise:halves.conditions: At least alpha n available positions;arbitrary deterministic supported zero-sum vector;alpha fixed in(0,1].
noise:halves.constants_and_limits: delta=alpha/2,eta_n=2exp(-alpha²n/4),gamma=1-alpha/4;w_s<=(1-delta)a_s+eta_n E0 for s>=d;a_t<=[gamma^(t-2d)+eta_n/delta]E0. Opposite halves independent only after the specified past split.

noise:uniform-marginals.statement: Two large specified-list endpoint estimates follow from conditional energy and sequential comparison.
noise:uniform-marginals.conditions: Every deterministic starting deck and fixed ordered list;fair cyclic switch law;n=2^d sufficiently large.
noise:uniform-marginals.constants_and_limits: 1024d,15n/16:error<=n^-3/2;256d,7n/8:error=o(1). Selected actual FixedLists/Main statically matches;not a new guarantee for full paths or every environment.

thm:base-path-joint.statement: A further ordered list is nearly uniform conditional on base labelled paths in actual-path expected TV.
thm:base-path-joint.conditions: Fix p in(0,1),base B size r0,disjoint list k;r0+k-1<=pn;all starts;fixed cyclic order or its reverse.
thm:base-path-joint.constants_and_limits: q=(1+p)/2,rho=(3+p)/4,c_p=-(1/8)log2 rho,b=ceil(10/c_p),T=2bd;meanTV<=k n^-4 eventually. Coarsening must determine available endpoint set. With half observed it does not directly cover ALL remaining half labels,which leave no fixed-fraction reservoir. No exact selected formal counterpart established.

lem:base-path-energy.statement: Any zero-sum signed vector contracts uniformly over two sweeps and iterates.
lem:base-path-energy.conditions: At most pn observed labels;p fixed<1;input supported on available sites;future coins independent after each past boundary.
lem:base-path-energy.constants_and_limits: E||f_2d||²<=n^-c_p E0,then2a sweeps n^-a c_p. Restart with past-only conditioning;full future paths define the same prefix-measurable vector but are averaged in the energy bound.

noise:subcubes.statement: Disjoint preceding-coordinate subcubes decorrelate mass energy from opposite-partner availability.
noise:subcubes.conditions: Uniform initial blocker subset independent of shuffle;tag centered vector;1<=L<d;old subcubes good-density r with probability1-eta.
noise:subcubes.constants_and_limits: w_s<=(1-r)a_s+eta for s>=L. Uniformity of available set is unconditional,not conditional on revealed paths.

noise:averaged-general.statement: Random complements of any fixed positive density have small mean endpoint TV.
noise:averaged-general.conditions: Fixed dyadic integer b>=2,q=1/b;uniform independent starting subset of size n-n/b;T=100bd.
noise:averaged-general.constants_and_limits: L=floor d/2;bad probability<=n(n+1)exp(-q2^L/8);meanTV=o(1). This route averages domains;not automatically every fixed domain.

noise:covariance-marginal.statement: A direct moment bound controls the mean three-quarter-list marginal.
noise:covariance-marginal.conditions: Uniform ordered list3n/4 independent of switches;T=1000d,L=floor d/2.
noise:covariance-marginal.constants_and_limits: eta_d=n[(7/4)2^-7/8]^(2^L);w<=7a/8+eta_d;a_T=o(n^-10). Sampling-without-replacement moment bound used before path conditioning.

noise:predictable-cosets.statement: One common retained subprobability has eight simultaneous complementary-coset caps.
noise:predictable-cosets.conditions: T=2048d;one deterministic equal eight-block partition and complement orders selected by averaging.
noise:predictable-cosets.constants_and_limits: Mass>=1-8n^-11;cap2/[G:H_i]. Each next-card energy event measurable before its path;cannot condition on all good events and reuse unaltered conditional one-card laws.

noise:mixing.statement: Four different marginal/cap methods give separate full-deck linear clocks.
noise:mixing.conditions: Actual fair physical shuffle;whole-sweep independent blocks;appropriate distinct unread Fourier transfers,common retained mass and parity.
noise:mixing.constants_and_limits: 8192d sixteen-subgroup;16384d predictable;400*2^22 d peeling;16000d covariance. Alternative methods,not successively tighter bounds or finite engineering speedups.

mart:halves.statement: Conditional mass-squared times opposite availability factorizes across the previous coordinate split.
mart:halves.conditions: s>=d-1,a=s-d+1;independent intervening half arrays;both old half densities>=beta except a past-measurable event of probability eta.
mart:halves.constants_and_limits: Exact factor opposite old density times own-half energy;w_s<=(1-beta)a_s+eta. No independence of mass and available set within one half.

mart:balance.statement: Fixed and independently random initial domains furnish different valid half-balance tails.

cycles:sharp.constants_and_limits: Not inversion invariance of mu and not a consequence of image caps alone;sign and missing mass restored.

cycles:list-cap.conditions: T1026d,any periodic coordinate permutation;q<=7n/8;next-card good event depends only on preceding full paths.

cycles:two-sided-cap.constants_and_limits: Both masses>=1-16n^-9 and normalized subgroup density caps2;alpha may differ from beta. H_i g preimage and gH_i image constraints cannot be interchanged.

sweeps:two-sweep.statement: Block moments and merge recursion provide an explicit uniform two-sweep factor.

sweeps:collision.conditions: Deterministic available set H and signed vector x;hierarchical sister densities and fixed coordinate order.
sweeps:collision.constants_and_limits: Diagonal sum s_H({u})x(u)² plus sum_i2^(1-i)sum_B s_H(B)x(B0)x(B1),s_H(B)=product_ancestors(1-sisterdensity/2). Chronological independence of unexposed sister arrays is used after averaging paths.

sweeps:averaged.conditions: Uniform independent initial list;m>=epsilon n,epsilon1/q,q fixed dyadic;b=floor d/2.

sweeps:refresh.constants_and_limits: gamma1-epsilon/2;B_n2e^-epsilon n/8 or2e^-epsilon²n/4;a_t<=beta^(t-2d)+B_n/(1-gamma) if2beta-1>=gamma. Distinct valid tail arguments kept separate.

prefix:contraction.statement: After the first sweep,law-level prefix-tree symmetry contracts each subsequent sweep.

prefix:invariance.constants_and_limits: Deterministic coin reindexing/toggling proves invariance. Not invariance under every permutation or a uniform full deck.
